item.title: Former Congressman Wiley Nickel wins Wake County District Attorney race
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) — Former North Carolina Democratic congressman Wiley Nickel will be the next Wake County district attorney. Nickel won Tuesday night’s Democratic primary. He faced Melanie Shekita, an assistant district attorney with the Wake County District Attorney’s Office since 1998, and former prosecutor Sherita Walton, a legal advisor to the Raleigh Police Department. item.title: Buckhout wins congressional primary, will now face Rep. Don Davis
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) — Republican Laurie Buckhout will challenge Democratic incumbent Don Davis in November. Buckhout won Tuesday’s GOP primary for the 1st congressional district. This will be the second time the two candidates have faced each other in a general election. item.title: Incumbent Foushee declares victory in NC Congressional District 4, challenger Allam says she'll ask for recount
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) — Late Tuesday night, incumbent Valerie Foushee declared victory in the Democratic primary in North Carolina's 4th Congressional District. However, due to the small vote differential, challenger Nida Allam said she is planning to ask for a recount.
